list.name: scenario
list.label: Тип прогона
list.description: Фильтрует список прогонов и адаптивную таблицу деталей. Графики общие для всех сценариев: VU/RPS, задержки, отказы, ресурсы.
list.query:
SELECT r.scenario AS "__value",
       CASE r.scenario
         WHEN 'ramp' THEN 'Ramp (ступени)'
         WHEN 'stress' THEN 'Stress (baseline → overload → recovery)'
         WHEN 'soak' THEN 'Soak 10%'
         WHEN 'soak-errors' THEN 'Soak + ошибки'
         WHEN 'smoke' THEN 'Smoke'
         ELSE r.scenario
       END AS "__text"
FROM lt_runs r
WHERE COALESCE(r.config->>'workload', 'auth') = 'public'
GROUP BY r.scenario
ORDER BY CASE r.scenario
           WHEN 'ramp' THEN 1 WHEN 'stress' THEN 2 WHEN 'soak' THEN 3
           WHEN 'soak-errors' THEN 4 ELSE 5
         END

panels.title: ЛР4 — нагрузочное тестирование: методика и переключатели

options.content:
## ЛР4: нагрузочное тестирование vidayapi — `WORKLOAD=public`

**Эта доска содержит только прогоны `public`.** Сценарий: public: feed → video_detail → live_streams (без логина и записи).
Прогоны другого сценария — на отдельной доске
[`loadtest-lr4-auth`](/d/loadtest-lr4-auth), чтобы auth и
public не смешивались на одной оси X.

Каждый прогон использует отдельные образы приложения и генератора, чистый том
PostgreSQL и детерминированный сид. Нагрузку создаёт собственный Kotlin-генератор:
**корутины + собственный диспетчер с фиксированным пулом потоков**. Параметры железа,
корутин и потоков показаны в структурированных таблицах выбранного прогона.

**Переключатели сверху — только два:** **«Тип прогона»** (ramp / stress / soak /
soak-errors / smoke) и **«Прогон»**. Тип прогона фильтрует список прогонов и
адаптивную таблицу деталей; все графики ниже общие, потому что VU/RPS, задержки,
отказы, ресурсы и JVM нужны любому сценарию. Панелей «для другого сценария»,
которые всегда пустые, на доске нет.

**Live — первым делом.** Секция `LIVE` читает Prometheus (ресурсы контейнеров,
Actuator и live-метрики Kotlin-генератора) и **не зависит от выбранного прогона**:
запустите тест при открытой Grafana — RPS, VU, p95/p99, отказы, CPU и RAM появятся
в течение 10 с. Когда прогон завершится и импортируется в PostgreSQL, он появится
в списке «Прогон» (обновление списка — при смене таймпикера или перезагрузке).

**Главный график:** «VU и RPS во времени» — две оси на одном полотне. Именно по нему
видно, как рост виртуальных пользователей перестаёт давать прирост запросов, а затем
начинаются отказы. «Доля отказов в 5-с окне» с порогом 95% показывает падение сервиса:
несколько подряд полных окон выше порога — это и есть критерий ранней остановки.

**VU = корутина.** Генератор физически не может поднять больше виртуальных
пользователей, чем `COROUTINES`; ramp-план автоматически обрезается до этого потолка,
поэтому «RAMP_MAX_VUS=300 при COROUTINES=100» даст плато на 100 VU, а не 300.
Готовый сценарий падения на 1 CPU: `make loadtest-fail` (auth, 100 корутин,
RAM 256 MiB, ramp 10→100 VU, остановка по 3 окнам ≥95% отказов).

**Почему public не падает на 100 корутинах:** публичные чтения на 1 CPU держат
~1000–1100 RPS при p95 ~100 мс даже при 100% CPU; замкнутый контур из 100 запросов
не создаёт очередь в 2 с, поэтому 5xx/timeout не появляются. Для демонстрации отказа
нужен auth-сценарий с логином и записью — он падает уже на ~40–50 VU.

**Детали сценария** — одна адаптивная таблица: для ramp это ступени
(lt_ramp_curve: VU → RPS/p95/p99/отказы/стабильность), для stress/soak — фазы
(lt_phases: baseline → overload → recovery, RPS, перцентили и время восстановления).
Поэтому таблица всегда заполнена и не зависит от того, какой сценарий выбран.

**Время.** Все ряды построены по реальным таймстемпам (`bucket_ts` / `ts`) и
фильтруются таймпикером. В таблице «Прогоны в базе» клик по `run_id` открывает этот
же дашборд с таймпикером ровно на интервале прогона — удобно для коротких
early-stopped прогонов.

**Отказ** = 5xx / timeout / обрыв. Инъекции 4xx и бизнес-4xx отказом не считаются.
Ранняя остановка: после 30 с три подряд полных 5-с окна, в каждом ≥20 запросов и
≥95% отказов (успех ≤5%). CPU нормализован к лимиту контейнера: **100% = все
доступные ядра**. Перцентили p50/p95/p99 показаны на логарифмической оси.

Ссылки: [ЛР3 — микробенчмарк](/d/benchmark-lr3) ·
[`loadtest-lr4-auth`](/d/loadtest-lr4-auth) ·
[отчёт ЛР4](https://github.com/Snowkey505/viday/blob/main/vidayapi/docs/lr4.md) ·
[гайд](https://github.com/Snowkey505/viday/blob/main/vidayapi/docs/lr4-grafana-guide.md)

panels.title: LIVE: текущий прогон (Prometheus, обновление 10 с; не зависит от выбранного «Прогон»)
LIVE: текущий прогон (No data = сейчас ничего не запущено)
LIVE: CPU API, % от лимита контейнера
Прогоны выбранного типа: клик по run_id зумит таймпикер на его интервал

targets.rawSql:
WITH per_run AS (
  SELECT run_id,
         sum(requests) AS requests,
         sum(requests) / NULLIF(sum(duration_s), 0) AS rps,
         max(p50_ms) AS p50_ms,
         max(p95_ms) AS p95_ms,
         max(p99_ms) AS p99_ms,
         sum(errors_unexpected)::double precision
           / NULLIF(sum(requests), 0) * 100 AS fail_pct,
         sum(errors_injected)::double precision
           / NULLIF(sum(requests), 0) * 100 AS injected_pct,
         max(vus_max) AS vus_max
  FROM lt_scenario_summary
  WHERE scope = 'overall'
  GROUP BY run_id
)
SELECT r.run_id AS "прогон",
       r.profile AS "профиль",
       r.status AS "статус",
       COALESCE(r.config->>'workload', 'auth') AS "сценарий",
       COALESCE(r.config->>'api_cpus', '2') AS "CPU",
       COALESCE(r.config->>'api_ram_mb', '1536') AS "RAM MiB",
       COALESCE(r.config->>'coroutines', '-') AS "корутины",
       COALESCE(r.config->>'dispatcher_threads', '-') AS "потоки dispatcher",
       to_char(r.started_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS "старт",
       round(r.duration_s)::int AS "длит., с",
       round(r.error_rate_target * 100)::int AS "цель ошибок, %",
       p.requests AS "запросы",
       round(p.rps::numeric, 1) AS "RPS",
       round(p.p50_ms::numeric, 1) AS "p50 (макс. фаза), мс",
       round(p.p95_ms::numeric, 1) AS "p95 (макс. фаза), мс",
       round(p.p99_ms::numeric, 1) AS "p99 (макс. фаза), мс",
       round(p.fail_pct::numeric, 2) AS "отказы, %",
       round(p.injected_pct::numeric, 2) AS "инъекции, %",
       round(p.vus_max::numeric, 0) AS "VU max",
       CASE WHEN COALESCE(r.config->>'early_stopped', 'false')::boolean
            THEN 'да' ELSE 'нет' END AS "досрочно",
       COALESCE(r.config->>'termination_reason', '') AS "причина остановки",
       round(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM r.started_at) * 1000)::bigint AS from_ms,
       round(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM r.finished_at) * 1000)::bigint AS to_ms
FROM lt_runs r
LEFT JOIN per_run p ON p.run_id = r.run_id
WHERE COALESCE(r.config->>'workload', 'auth') = 'public'
  AND r.scenario = '$scenario'
ORDER BY r.started_at DESC

value.title: Открыть этот прогон (зум на его интервал)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT parameter AS "параметр", value AS "значение"
FROM lt_runs r
CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES
  ('Процессор', COALESCE(r.environment->>'cpu_model', 'не указан')),
  ('CPU limit API, ядер', COALESCE(r.config->>'api_cpus', 'не указан')),
  ('CPU cpuset API', COALESCE(r.environment->'cpusets'->>'api', 'не указан')),
  ('RAM limit API, MiB', COALESCE(r.config->>'api_ram_mb', 'не указан')),
  ('JVM heap Xmx, MiB', COALESCE(r.config->>'api_heap_mb', 'не указан')),
  ('JVM heap Xms, MiB', COALESCE(r.config->>'api_xms_mb', 'не указан')),
  ('RAM хоста доступно на старте, MiB', COALESCE(r.environment->>'host_mem_available_mb_at_start', 'не указано'))
) AS v(parameter, value)
WHERE r.run_id = (SELECT COALESCE((SELECT run_id FROM lt_runs WHERE run_id = NULLIF('$run', '') AND scenario = '$scenario' AND COALESCE(config->>'workload', 'auth') = 'public'), (SELECT run_id FROM lt_runs WHERE scenario = '$scenario' AND COALESCE(config->>'workload', 'auth') = 'public' ORDER BY started_at DESC LIMIT 1)))

panels.title: Конфигурация нагрузки: корутины, потоки и критерий отказа

targets.rawSql:
SELECT parameter AS "параметр", value AS "значение"
FROM lt_runs r
CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES
  ('Тип сценария', COALESCE(r.config->>'workload', 'auth')),
  ('Временной профиль', r.scenario),
  ('Генератор', COALESCE(r.config->>'generator', 'k6')),
  ('Корутины', COALESCE(r.config->>'coroutines', 'не применимо')),
  ('Потоки dispatcher', COALESCE(r.config->>'dispatcher_threads', 'не применимо')),
  ('Ramp: макс. VU в конфиге', COALESCE(r.config->>'ramp_max_vus', '—')),
  ('Потолок VU (COROUTINES)', COALESCE(r.config->>'coroutines', '—')),
  ('Операции на сессию', COALESCE(r.config->>'operations_per_session', '10')),
  ('Timeout запроса', COALESCE(r.config->>'request_timeout', 'не указан')),
  ('Критерий критического отказа', COALESCE(
     (r.config->>'failure_windows') || ' окна × ' || (r.config->>'failure_window') ||
     ', отказы ≥ ' || round(((r.config->>'failure_threshold')::numeric * 100), 0)::text || '%, запросов ≥ ' ||
     (r.config->>'failure_min_requests'), 'старый прогон: см. config'))
) AS v(parameter, value)
WHERE r.run_id = (SELECT COALESCE((SELECT run_id FROM lt_runs WHERE run_id = NULLIF('$run', '') AND scenario = '$scenario' AND COALESCE(config->>'workload', 'auth') = 'public'), (SELECT run_id FROM lt_runs WHERE scenario = '$scenario' AND COALESCE(config->>'workload', 'auth') = 'public' ORDER BY started_at DESC LIMIT 1)))

SELECT sum(requests)::bigint FROM lt_scenario_summary WHERE run_id = (SELECT COALESCE((SELECT run_id FROM lt_runs WHERE run_id = NULLIF('$run', '') AND scenario = '$scenario' AND COALESCE(config->>'workload', 'auth') = 'public'), (SELECT run_id FROM lt_runs WHERE scenario = '$scenario' AND COALESCE(config->>'workload', 'auth') = 'public' ORDER BY started_at DESC LIMIT 1))) AND scope = 'overall' AND operation = 'all'

SELECT round((sum(requests) / NULLIF(sum(duration_s),0))::numeric, 1) FROM lt_scenario_summary WHERE run_id = (SELECT COALESCE((SELECT run_id FROM lt_runs WHERE run_id = NULLIF('$run', '') AND scenario = '$scenario' AND COALESCE(config->>'workload', 'auth') = 'public'), (SELECT run_id FROM lt_runs WHERE scenario = '$scenario' AND COALESCE(config->>'workload', 'auth') = 'public' ORDER BY started_at DESC LIMIT 1))) AND scope = 'overall' AND operation = 'all'

SELECT round(max(p95_ms)::numeric, 1) FROM lt_scenario_summary WHERE run_id = (SELECT COALESCE((SELECT run_id FROM lt_runs WHERE run_id = NULLIF('$run', '') AND scenario = '$scenario' AND COALESCE(config->>'workload', 'auth') = 'public'), (SELECT run_id FROM lt_runs WHERE scenario = '$scenario' AND COALESCE(config->>'workload', 'auth') = 'public' ORDER BY started_at DESC LIMIT 1))) AND scope = 'overall' AND operation = 'all'

SELECT round(max(p99_ms)::numeric, 1) FROM lt_scenario_summary WHERE run_id = (SELECT COALESCE((SELECT run_id FROM lt_runs WHERE run_id = NULLIF('$run', '') AND scenario = '$scenario' AND COALESCE(config->>'workload', 'auth') = 'public'), (SELECT run_id FROM lt_runs WHERE scenario = '$scenario' AND COALESCE(config->>'workload', 'auth') = 'public' ORDER BY started_at DESC LIMIT 1))) AND scope = 'overall' AND operation = 'all'

SELECT round((sum(errors_unexpected)::double precision / NULLIF(sum(requests),0) * 100)::numeric, 2) FROM lt_scenario_summary WHERE run_id = (SELECT COALESCE((SELECT run_id FROM lt_runs WHERE run_id = NULLIF('$run', '') AND scenario = '$scenario' AND COALESCE(config->>'workload', 'auth') = 'public'), (SELECT run_id FROM lt_runs WHERE scenario = '$scenario' AND COALESCE(config->>'workload', 'auth') = 'public' ORDER BY started_at DESC LIMIT 1))) AND scope = 'overall' AND operation = 'all'

SELECT round((sum(errors_injected)::double precision / NULLIF(sum(requests),0) * 100)::numeric, 2) FROM lt_scenario_summary WHERE run_id = (SELECT COALESCE((SELECT run_id FROM lt_runs WHERE run_id = NULLIF('$run', '') AND scenario = '$scenario' AND COALESCE(config->>'workload', 'auth') = 'public'), (SELECT run_id FROM lt_runs WHERE scenario = '$scenario' AND COALESCE(config->>'workload', 'auth') = 'public' ORDER BY started_at DESC LIMIT 1))) AND scope = 'overall' AND operation = 'all'

panels.title: Отказы: пик, окна выше порога и первое падение

targets.rawSql:
SELECT round((max(errors_unexpected::double precision
                  / NULLIF(requests, 0) * 100))::numeric, 2)
FROM lt_timeseries
WHERE run_id = (SELECT COALESCE((SELECT run_id FROM lt_runs WHERE run_id = NULLIF('$run', '') AND scenario = '$scenario' AND COALESCE(config->>'workload', 'auth') = 'public'), (SELECT run_id FROM lt_runs WHERE scenario = '$scenario' AND COALESCE(config->>'workload', 'auth') = 'public' ORDER BY started_at DESC LIMIT 1))) AND operation = 'all' AND requests > 0

SELECT count(*)::int
FROM lt_timeseries
WHERE run_id = (SELECT COALESCE((SELECT run_id FROM lt_runs WHERE run_id = NULLIF('$run', '') AND scenario = '$scenario' AND COALESCE(config->>'workload', 'auth') = 'public'), (SELECT run_id FROM lt_runs WHERE scenario = '$scenario' AND COALESCE(config->>'workload', 'auth') = 'public' ORDER BY started_at DESC LIMIT 1))) AND operation = 'all' AND requests >= 20
  AND errors_unexpected::double precision >= 0.95 * requests

panels.title: Первый таймстемп окна, где отказов больше успехов

targets.rawSql:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT bucket_ts, requests, errors_unexpected
  FROM lt_timeseries
  WHERE run_id = (SELECT COALESCE((SELECT run_id FROM lt_runs WHERE run_id = NULLIF('$run', '') AND scenario = '$scenario' AND COALESCE(config->>'workload', 'auth') = 'public'), (SELECT run_id FROM lt_runs WHERE scenario = '$scenario' AND COALESCE(config->>'workload', 'auth') = 'public' ORDER BY started_at DESC LIMIT 1))) AND $__timeFilter(bucket_ts) AND operation = 'all'
),
crossing AS (
  SELECT b.bucket_ts
  FROM base b
  WHERE b.requests > 0 AND b.errors_unexpected > b.requests - b.errors_unexpected
  ORDER BY b.bucket_ts
  LIMIT 1
)
-- Возвращаем именно таймстемп первого окна, а не секунды от старта.
SELECT COALESCE(
         to_char((SELECT bucket_ts FROM crossing), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'),
         'не достигнуто'
       ) AS value

panels.title: Нагрузка во времени: VU → RPS, задержки, отказы и доля отказов
VU и RPS во времени: рост пользователей и фактический поток запросов

targets.rawSql:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT bucket_ts, rps, vus
  FROM lt_timeseries
  WHERE run_id = (SELECT COALESCE((SELECT run_id FROM lt_runs WHERE run_id = NULLIF('$run', '') AND scenario = '$scenario' AND COALESCE(config->>'workload', 'auth') = 'public'), (SELECT run_id FROM lt_runs WHERE scenario = '$scenario' AND COALESCE(config->>'workload', 'auth') = 'public' ORDER BY started_at DESC LIMIT 1))) AND $__timeFilter(bucket_ts) AND operation = 'all'
)
SELECT b.bucket_ts AS "time",
       round(sum(b.rps)::numeric, 2) AS "RPS",
       round(avg(b.vus)::numeric, 1) AS "VU"
FROM base b
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

WITH base AS (
  SELECT bucket_ts, p50_ms, p95_ms, p99_ms
  FROM lt_timeseries
  WHERE run_id = (SELECT COALESCE((SELECT run_id FROM lt_runs WHERE run_id = NULLIF('$run', '') AND scenario = '$scenario' AND COALESCE(config->>'workload', 'auth') = 'public'), (SELECT run_id FROM lt_runs WHERE scenario = '$scenario' AND COALESCE(config->>'workload', 'auth') = 'public' ORDER BY started_at DESC LIMIT 1))) AND $__timeFilter(bucket_ts) AND operation = 'all'
),
long AS (
  SELECT bucket_ts, 'p50' AS metric, p50_ms AS value
  FROM base UNION ALL 
  SELECT bucket_ts, 'p95' AS metric, p95_ms AS value
  FROM base UNION ALL 
  SELECT bucket_ts, 'p99' AS metric, p99_ms AS value
  FROM base
)
SELECT bucket_ts AS "time", metric, round(value::numeric, 2) AS "value"
FROM long
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Отказы, инъекции и бизнес-4xx в 5-с окне

targets.rawSql:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT bucket_ts, errors_unexpected, errors_injected, errors_business
  FROM lt_timeseries
  WHERE run_id = (SELECT COALESCE((SELECT run_id FROM lt_runs WHERE run_id = NULLIF('$run', '') AND scenario = '$scenario' AND COALESCE(config->>'workload', 'auth') = 'public'), (SELECT run_id FROM lt_runs WHERE scenario = '$scenario' AND COALESCE(config->>'workload', 'auth') = 'public' ORDER BY started_at DESC LIMIT 1))) AND $__timeFilter(bucket_ts) AND operation = 'all'
)
SELECT b.bucket_ts AS "time",
       sum(b.errors_unexpected)::double precision AS "отказы (5xx/timeout)",
       sum(b.errors_injected)::double precision AS "инъекции 4xx",
       sum(b.errors_business)::double precision AS "прочие 4xx"
FROM base b
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Доля отказов в 5-с окне, % (порог 95% = критерий остановки)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT bucket_ts AS "time",
       round((sum(errors_unexpected)::double precision
              / NULLIF(sum(requests), 0) * 100)::numeric, 2) AS "отказы, %"
FROM lt_timeseries
WHERE run_id = (SELECT COALESCE((SELECT run_id FROM lt_runs WHERE run_id = NULLIF('$run', '') AND scenario = '$scenario' AND COALESCE(config->>'workload', 'auth') = 'public'), (SELECT run_id FROM lt_runs WHERE scenario = '$scenario' AND COALESCE(config->>'workload', 'auth') = 'public' ORDER BY started_at DESC LIMIT 1))) AND $__timeFilter(bucket_ts) AND operation = 'all'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Накопленные успешные операции и отказы от начала прогона

targets.rawSql:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT bucket_ts, requests, errors_unexpected
  FROM lt_timeseries
  WHERE run_id = (SELECT COALESCE((SELECT run_id FROM lt_runs WHERE run_id = NULLIF('$run', '') AND scenario = '$scenario' AND COALESCE(config->>'workload', 'auth') = 'public'), (SELECT run_id FROM lt_runs WHERE scenario = '$scenario' AND COALESCE(config->>'workload', 'auth') = 'public' ORDER BY started_at DESC LIMIT 1))) AND $__timeFilter(bucket_ts) AND operation = 'all'
)
SELECT b.bucket_ts AS "time",
       sum(b.requests - b.errors_unexpected) OVER (ORDER BY b.bucket_ts)::bigint
         AS "успешные операции, накоплено",
       sum(b.errors_unexpected) OVER (ORDER BY b.bucket_ts)::bigint
         AS "отказы, накоплено"
FROM base b
ORDER BY b.bucket_ts

panels.title: Детали сценария (адаптивно): ramp → ступени VU; stress/soak → фазы и время восстановления

targets.rawSql:
WITH meta AS (
  SELECT scenario FROM lt_runs WHERE run_id = (SELECT COALESCE((SELECT run_id FROM lt_runs WHERE run_id = NULLIF('$run', '') AND scenario = '$scenario' AND COALESCE(config->>'workload', 'auth') = 'public'), (SELECT run_id FROM lt_runs WHERE scenario = '$scenario' AND COALESCE(config->>'workload', 'auth') = 'public' ORDER BY started_at DESC LIMIT 1)))
),
ramp_rows AS (
  SELECT target_vus::double precision AS ord,
         'ступень ' || target_vus || ' VU' AS label,
         target_vus::double precision AS vus,
         requests,
         rps,
         p95_ms,
         p99_ms,
         unexpected_error_rate_pct AS fail_pct,
         NULL::text AS recovery_text,
         stable
  FROM lt_ramp_curve
  WHERE run_id = (SELECT COALESCE((SELECT run_id FROM lt_runs WHERE run_id = NULLIF('$run', '') AND scenario = '$scenario' AND COALESCE(config->>'workload', 'auth') = 'public'), (SELECT run_id FROM lt_runs WHERE scenario = '$scenario' AND COALESCE(config->>'workload', 'auth') = 'public' ORDER BY started_at DESC LIMIT 1)))
    AND (SELECT scenario FROM meta) = 'ramp'
),
phase_rows AS (
  SELECT EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM p.started_at) AS ord,
         p.phase AS label,
         (SELECT max(t.vus) FROM lt_timeseries t
           WHERE t.run_id = p.run_id AND t.phase = p.phase AND t.operation = 'all') AS vus,
         p.requests,
         p.rps,
         p.p95_ms,
         p.p99_ms,
         p.unexpected_error_rate_pct AS fail_pct,
         COALESCE(round(p.recovery_s::numeric, 0)::text, '—') AS recovery_text,
         (p.unexpected_error_rate_pct < 1 AND p.p95_ms < 500) AS stable
  FROM lt_phases p
  WHERE p.run_id = (SELECT COALESCE((SELECT run_id FROM lt_runs WHERE run_id = NULLIF('$run', '') AND scenario = '$scenario' AND COALESCE(config->>'workload', 'auth') = 'public'), (SELECT run_id FROM lt_runs WHERE scenario = '$scenario' AND COALESCE(config->>'workload', 'auth') = 'public' ORDER BY started_at DESC LIMIT 1)))
    AND (SELECT scenario FROM meta) <> 'ramp'
),
rows AS (
  SELECT * FROM ramp_rows
  UNION ALL
  SELECT * FROM phase_rows
)
SELECT label AS "ступень / фаза",
       round(vus::numeric, 0) AS "VU",
       requests AS "запросов",
       round(rps::numeric, 1) AS "RPS",
       round(p95_ms::numeric, 1) AS "p95, мс",
       round(p99_ms::numeric, 1) AS "p99, мс",
       round(fail_pct::numeric, 2) AS "отказы, %",
       COALESCE(recovery_text, '—') AS "восстановление, с",
       CASE WHEN stable THEN 'да' ELSE 'нет' END AS "стабильно"
FROM rows
ORDER BY ord

panels.title: Распределение задержек: CDF и гистограмма (X — таймстемпы)
CDF во времени: доля запросов ≤ порога

targets.rawSql:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT bucket_ts, latency_ms, max(fraction) AS fraction
  FROM lt_cdf_ts
  WHERE run_id = (SELECT COALESCE((SELECT run_id FROM lt_runs WHERE run_id = NULLIF('$run', '') AND scenario = '$scenario' AND COALESCE(config->>'workload', 'auth') = 'public'), (SELECT run_id FROM lt_runs WHERE scenario = '$scenario' AND COALESCE(config->>'workload', 'auth') = 'public' ORDER BY started_at DESC LIMIT 1))) AND $__timeFilter(bucket_ts) AND operation = 'all'
  GROUP BY bucket_ts, latency_ms
)
SELECT bucket_ts AS "time",
       round(max(fraction) FILTER (WHERE latency_ms = 10)::numeric, 3) AS "≤10 мс", round(max(fraction) FILTER (WHERE latency_ms = 25)::numeric, 3) AS "≤25 мс", round(max(fraction) FILTER (WHERE latency_ms = 50)::numeric, 3) AS "≤50 мс", round(max(fraction) FILTER (WHERE latency_ms = 100)::numeric, 3) AS "≤100 мс", round(max(fraction) FILTER (WHERE latency_ms = 200)::numeric, 3) AS "≤200 мс", round(max(fraction) FILTER (WHERE latency_ms = 500)::numeric, 3) AS "≤500 мс", round(max(fraction) FILTER (WHERE latency_ms = 1000)::numeric, 3) AS "≤1000 мс", round(max(fraction) FILTER (WHERE latency_ms = 2000)::numeric, 3) AS "≤2000 мс", round(max(fraction) FILTER (WHERE latency_ms = 5000)::numeric, 3) AS "≤5000 мс", round(max(fraction) FILTER (WHERE latency_ms = 10000)::numeric, 3) AS "≤10000 мс"
FROM base
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Гистограмма задержки во времени (Y — мс, цвет — запросы)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT bucket_ts AS "time",
       round(((from_ms + to_ms) / 2.0)::numeric, 1) AS "latency_ms",
       sum(count)::bigint AS "requests"
FROM lt_histogram_ts
WHERE run_id = (SELECT COALESCE((SELECT run_id FROM lt_runs WHERE run_id = NULLIF('$run', '') AND scenario = '$scenario' AND COALESCE(config->>'workload', 'auth') = 'public'), (SELECT run_id FROM lt_runs WHERE scenario = '$scenario' AND COALESCE(config->>'workload', 'auth') = 'public' ORDER BY started_at DESC LIMIT 1))) AND $__timeFilter(bucket_ts) AND operation = 'all'
GROUP BY bucket_ts, from_ms, to_ms
ORDER BY 1, 2

panels.title: Сводка по операциям: запросы, RPS, p50/p95/p99, отказы

targets.rawSql:
SELECT operation AS "операция",
       sum(requests) AS "запросов",
       round((sum(requests) / NULLIF(sum(duration_s), 0))::numeric, 1) AS "RPS",
       round(max(p50_ms)::numeric, 1) AS "p50",
       round(max(p95_ms)::numeric, 1) AS "p95",
       round(max(p99_ms)::numeric, 1) AS "p99",
       sum(errors_unexpected) AS "отказы",
       sum(errors_injected) AS "инъекции"
FROM lt_scenario_summary
WHERE run_id = (SELECT COALESCE((SELECT run_id FROM lt_runs WHERE run_id = NULLIF('$run', '') AND scenario = '$scenario' AND COALESCE(config->>'workload', 'auth') = 'public'), (SELECT run_id FROM lt_runs WHERE scenario = '$scenario' AND COALESCE(config->>'workload', 'auth') = 'public' ORDER BY started_at DESC LIMIT 1))) AND scope = 'operation'
GROUP BY operation
ORDER BY sum(requests) DESC

SELECT operation AS "операция",
       round(max(p95_ms)::numeric, 1) AS "p95, мс"
FROM lt_scenario_summary
WHERE run_id = (SELECT COALESCE((SELECT run_id FROM lt_runs WHERE run_id = NULLIF('$run', '') AND scenario = '$scenario' AND COALESCE(config->>'workload', 'auth') = 'public'), (SELECT run_id FROM lt_runs WHERE scenario = '$scenario' AND COALESCE(config->>'workload', 'auth') = 'public' ORDER BY started_at DESC LIMIT 1))) AND scope = 'operation'
GROUP BY operation
ORDER BY max(requests) DESC
LIMIT 15

  SELECT ts, component, (cpu_pct) AS value
  FROM lt_resource_samples
  WHERE run_id = (SELECT COALESCE((SELECT run_id FROM lt_runs WHERE run_id = NULLIF('$run', '') AND scenario = '$scenario' AND COALESCE(config->>'workload', 'auth') = 'public'), (SELECT run_id FROM lt_runs WHERE scenario = '$scenario' AND COALESCE(config->>'workload', 'auth') = 'public' ORDER BY started_at DESC LIMIT 1))) AND $__timeFilter(ts)
)

       round(max(b.value) FILTER (WHERE b.component = 'api')::numeric, 2) AS "api",
       round(max(b.value) FILTER (WHERE b.component = 'postgres')::numeric, 2) AS "postgres",
       round(max(b.value) FILTER (WHERE b.component = 'redis')::numeric, 2) AS "redis",

       round(max(b.value) FILTER (WHERE b.component IN ('k6', 'generator'))::numeric, 2) AS "generator"

ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Ресурсы: min / max / median по компонентам
CPU / RAM / диск / сеть: min-max-median за весь прогон

targets.rawSql:
SELECT component AS "компонент",
       samples AS "сэмплов",
       round(cpu_min::numeric, 2) || ' / ' || round(cpu_max::numeric, 2)
         || ' / ' || round(cpu_median::numeric, 2) AS "CPU %, min/max/median",
       round((ram_min / 1048576.0)::numeric, 1) || ' / '
         || round((ram_max / 1048576.0)::numeric, 1) || ' / '
         || round((ram_median / 1048576.0)::numeric, 1) AS "RAM MiB, min/max/median",
       round((disk_read_median / 1048576.0)::numeric, 2) AS "диск чтение MiB/s (med)",
       round((disk_write_median / 1048576.0)::numeric, 2) AS "диск запись MiB/s (med)",
       round((net_rx_median / 1048576.0)::numeric, 2) AS "сеть rx MiB/s (med)",
       round((net_tx_median / 1048576.0)::numeric, 2) AS "сеть tx MiB/s (med)",
       pids_max AS "pids max"
FROM lt_resources
WHERE run_id = (SELECT COALESCE((SELECT run_id FROM lt_runs WHERE run_id = NULLIF('$run', '') AND scenario = '$scenario' AND COALESCE(config->>'workload', 'auth') = 'public'), (SELECT run_id FROM lt_runs WHERE scenario = '$scenario' AND COALESCE(config->>'workload', 'auth') = 'public' ORDER BY started_at DESC LIMIT 1))) AND scenario = 'all'
ORDER BY component

SELECT phase AS "фаза",
       component AS "компонент",
       round(cpu_median::numeric, 2) AS "CPU med, %",
       round(cpu_max::numeric, 2) AS "CPU max, %",
       round((ram_median / 1048576.0)::numeric, 1) AS "RAM med, MiB",
       round((ram_max / 1048576.0)::numeric, 1) AS "RAM max, MiB",
       round((disk_write_median / 1048576.0)::numeric, 2) AS "disk write med, MiB/s",
       round((disk_read_median / 1048576.0)::numeric, 2) AS "disk read med, MiB/s"
FROM lt_resources
WHERE run_id = (SELECT COALESCE((SELECT run_id FROM lt_runs WHERE run_id = NULLIF('$run', '') AND scenario = '$scenario' AND COALESCE(config->>'workload', 'auth') = 'public'), (SELECT run_id FROM lt_runs WHERE scenario = '$scenario' AND COALESCE(config->>'workload', 'auth') = 'public' ORDER BY started_at DESC LIMIT 1))) AND phase <> 'all'
ORDER BY phase, component

SELECT key AS "параметр", value AS "значение"
FROM lt_runs r, jsonb_each_text(r.config)
WHERE r.run_id = (SELECT COALESCE((SELECT run_id FROM lt_runs WHERE run_id = NULLIF('$run', '') AND scenario = '$scenario' AND COALESCE(config->>'workload', 'auth') = 'public'), (SELECT run_id FROM lt_runs WHERE scenario = '$scenario' AND COALESCE(config->>'workload', 'auth') = 'public' ORDER BY started_at DESC LIMIT 1)))
ORDER BY key

SELECT key AS "параметр", value AS "значение"
FROM lt_runs r, jsonb_each_text(r.environment)
WHERE r.run_id = (SELECT COALESCE((SELECT run_id FROM lt_runs WHERE run_id = NULLIF('$run', '') AND scenario = '$scenario' AND COALESCE(config->>'workload', 'auth') = 'public'), (SELECT run_id FROM lt_runs WHERE scenario = '$scenario' AND COALESCE(config->>'workload', 'auth') = 'public' ORDER BY started_at DESC LIMIT 1)))
ORDER BY key

panels.title: Автоматические выводы: стабильная зона, восстановление, тренд RAM

targets.rawSql:
SELECT kind AS "тип", key AS "показатель", value AS "значение", detail AS "детали"
FROM lt_findings
WHERE run_id = (SELECT COALESCE((SELECT run_id FROM lt_runs WHERE run_id = NULLIF('$run', '') AND scenario = '$scenario' AND COALESCE(config->>'workload', 'auth') = 'public'), (SELECT run_id FROM lt_runs WHERE scenario = '$scenario' AND COALESCE(config->>'workload', 'auth') = 'public' ORDER BY started_at DESC LIMIT 1)))

       'Короткий smoke или стабильный прогон: пороги ramp/recovery/early-stop не активированы'
WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM lt_findings WHERE run_id = (SELECT COALESCE((SELECT run_id FROM lt_runs WHERE run_id = NULLIF('$run', '') AND scenario = '$scenario' AND COALESCE(config->>'workload', 'auth') = 'public'), (SELECT run_id FROM lt_runs WHERE scenario = '$scenario' AND COALESCE(config->>'workload', 'auth') = 'public' ORDER BY started_at DESC LIMIT 1))))
ORDER BY 1, 2

options.content:
### Отчёты

- [ЛР3 — микробенчмарк](/d/benchmark-lr3)
- [Prometheus](http://localhost:9090)
- Markdown-отчёт: `docs/lr4.md`, результаты: `docs/lr4-results/<run-id>/`

### Что считается ошибкой

- **отказы** — 5xx, timeout, обрыв (входят в error rate SLO);
- **инъекции 4xx** — намеренно ошибочные операции (10%/20% тесты);
- **прочие 4xx** — бизнес-ответы сценария (409 «уже подписан» и т.п.).
